items.h: Records two total TDs on Sunday
items.s: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals. Arizona's defense had been plenty exploitable this season, allowing 243.7 yards per game and 17 TDs through the air to opposing QBs heading into Week 8 action. Even with his main skill-position talents available Sunday, though, Prescott didn't crack 200 passing yards for the first time since Week 1. He salvaged his day with his first TD on the ground of the campaign, which supplemented a nine-yard TD connection with WR Ryan Flournoy. Prescott and the Cowboys offense will look to get back on track next…

items.h: Dak Prescott records two touchdowns in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 20 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8. Prescott was unable to find consistent success Sunday, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a leaky Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

Dak Prescott A Must-Start QB1 Vs Cardinals In Week 8
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott should not be left out of starting lineups in any fantasy football leagues in Week 8. He gets a home matchup with the Arizona Cardinals, who are simply a bad team with a bad defense that's been torn to shreds by opposing quarterbacks this season. If you simply started the QB that faced Arizona each week, you'd have gotten an average of 22.3 fantasy points per game, which would rank as the No. 2 overall quarterback in fantasy football if it were done by one player. items.h: Dak Prescott tosses three touchdowns in win Monday
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 212 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Prescott had a pretty nice showing on Monday night. He totaled over 200 yards on the night and was able to score three touchdowns while leading the Cowboys to a comfortable win over Philadelphia. He will continue to be a good depth piece or streaming option in most leagues moving forward.

items.h: Trio of TDs in Week 7 win
items.s: Prescott completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for eight yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night. He also had a two-point conversion run. The Cowboys were able to keep Prescott upright throughout the night, and the veteran signal-caller leveraged the solid protection into his first multi-touchdown-pass tally since Week 2. Prescott connected with CeeDee Lamb (nine, 16 yards) and George Pickens (21 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and although his 55.6 percent completion rate was a season low, Prescott was able to steer clear of interceptions after throwing two apiece in Weeks 5 and 6.…

items.h: Dak Prescott A Borderline Top-10 QB In Fantasy Football For Week 7
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott still ranks as the QB12 in fantasy football leagues despite a string of disappointing losses. He's had a safe floor this season, as he's scored double-digit PPR fantasy points in all six of his games so far. The Cowboys will face the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 7. They're a favorable matchup for opposing QBs on paper, as they allow the ninth-most fantasy points to the position per game this season. That said, matchups with the NFC East are often strange in nature, and can be hard to predict. The Eagles offense has struggled all season, and now is missing its starting quarterback, Jalen Hurts (deep vein thrombosis). This should give Dallas an…

items.h: Dak Prescott throws one TD in Week 6 loss
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 34 of his 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions while adding two rushes for seven yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6. Prescott and the Cowboys were shut out by the Packers in the first half before showing some life after halftime. The veteran's lone TD pass went to Ryan Flournoy with 44 seconds left in the contest. Prescott survived an injury scare in the first half as he took a huge hit after a pass attempt and appeared to be favoring his ribs. He ultimately didn't miss any time in the game, but it is something worth monitoring this week. Prescott has now thrown for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games…

items.h: Late TD not enough in Week 6 loss
items.s: Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards. Prescott threw for just 86 yards with two interceptions in the first half, and the Cowboys took a 17-0 deficit into the locker room. He was only moderately more effective in the second half as Dallas looked out of sorts offensively for a second consecutive game in primetime. Prescott's lone touchdown pass was a six-yarder to Ryan Flournoy in the final minute of the fourth quarter. Dallas dropped to 2-4 with Sunday night's loss, and Dak has an ugly 4:4 TD:INT over his last four starts after posting a 6:1 mark through Week 2.…

items.h: Dak Prescott Still A Fantasy Football QB1 in Week 6 at Packers
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott will face the Green Bay Packers on the road in Week 6 after a disappointing performance in Week 5. He failed to lift the Cowboys to a win against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers sans their starting quarterback, Baker Mayfield (thumb). This week, he'll face one of the tougher defenses against quarterbacks in the NFL -- Green Bay has allowed the fifth-fewest fantasy points per game to opposing QBs this season. It looks like wide receiver CeeDee Lamb will return for Week 6 without restrictions, but he may still be slowed down by the thigh injury that affected him in Week 5. Prescott wasn't very effective with Lamb out of the lineup, and threw just one…

items.h: Dak Prescott Remains a High-Floor QB1 With High-End Volume
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw two interceptions in the upset loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last Thursday night, but he still managed to throw for over 300 yards for the second straight week on 42 passing attempts while adding one touchdown. Dallas' offense struggled as a whole, though, and it did not help matters that star receiver CeeDee Lamb suffered a quadriceps injury in the second half and was unavailable to return late in the fourth quarter. He has only thrown one touchdown in each of the last three games after starting the 2026 campaign with six touchdown passes and just one pick in the first two contests. The four-time Pro Bowler has thrown for 1,381 yards, nine…

items.h: Dak Prescott throws for 316 yards in loss
items.s: Dak Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards and a touchdown with two picks in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs. It was not Dak's best showing, struggling against a secondary that had been picked on up to this point in the season. He will look to right the ship against the Packers on Sunday Night Football a little over a week from now.

items.h: Piles up yards late in Week 5 loss
items.s: Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers on Thursday night. Prescott's final yardage number was sure to please fantasy managers, but there was a pretty sizable gulf between that figure and the veteran signal-caller's actual play-to-play performance most of the night. Prescott and the air attack struggled through more than a half against an aggressive Buccaneers defense, including on a third-quarter interception that led to a Tampa Bay touchdown. However, he came alive on a mid-fourth-quarter drive where the Cowboys sped up the pace, capping that 10-play, 99-yard possession off with an 18-yard…

items.h: Dak Prescott's Fantasy Value On Shakier Ground After Week 5 Loss
items.s: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott was poised to heavily exploit the porous secondary of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in their Week 5 contest on Thursday Night Football. Instead, he threw two interceptions and managed just one passing touchdown, though his 316 passing yards were adequate. One of the picks wasn't his fault, though -- it was tight end Jake Ferguson who failed to corral a pass that hit him in the hands, and the ricochet flew high in the air and landed in the hands of a Bucs defender. Prescott's fantasy value is likely to take a hit due to the injury to his elite WR1, CeeDee Lamb (quad), but Prescott still scored over 14.6 PPR fantasy points in the loss. It was his lowest…

items.h: Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans. He added seven yards on two carries.
items.s: A surreal 21 of Prescott's 45 attempts went to CeeDee Lamb, and the duo connected on a 12-yard TD with just 40 seconds left in the game for the game-winning score after Javonte Williams had scored Dallas' first three touchdowns in the second half as part of a comeback from a 16-6 halftime deficit. The 335 passing yards (189 of them to Lamb) were a season high for Prescott, and he'll take an 8:1 TD:INT through four games into a Week 5 battle at home against the Buccaneers.
